name: Bulgaria
notes: National Assembly: 240 seats in 31 multi-member constituencies (modelled on the 28 provinces, Sofia-city's three and Plovdiv's two merged), open-list proportional with the largest-remainder Hare quota, 4% threshold. 2026 result: Progressive Bulgaria 43.9% (131 seats), GERB-SDS 13.2% (39), PP-DB 12.4% (37), DPS 7.0% (21), Vazrazhdane 4.2% (12). Polling tracked after the 19 April 2026 election; the next election is due by 30 June 2030. The per-province baselines were rebuilt 2026-10-12 from the official CEC opendata (results.cik.bg/pe202604/opendata: real per-MIR shares replace the 2021-pattern proxies; PP-DB ran as one list, so the split pp/db projection bases are its real geography divided by the 5.5/6.9 national ratio). The projection blends 0.75*2026 + 0.25*2024 geography (CEC pe202410 export) via baseBlend; result views stay pure 2026. scraper/build_bg_base.py rebuilds both layers.
